story: Fair Fasteners began with a straightforward goal: help teams in the field and on the line get the right hardware, documented and delivered without friction. What started as a sourcing problem became a company built on specification-grade product, traceable supply, and support that respects how work actually gets done.

members.name: Alex Morgan
note: I spent years watching procurement and installation teams lose days to inconsistent lots, missing paperwork, and last-minute substitutions. We started Fair Fasteners to make supply predictable—so the part on the truck matches the part on the drawing.
My focus is building programs that scale: audited sourcing, clear labeling, and fulfillment that keeps pace with retrofit schedules and OEM runs alike.

members.name: Jordan Lee
note: Fasteners fail in the details—grade, coating, torque, corrosion class. I joined Alex because too many projects treat hardware as an afterthought until something seizes, strips, or fails inspection.
Today I work with customers on joint design, material selection, and field troubleshooting. Our job is to help you stay compliant without slowing the job site or the production line.
